incident agent step and BE-owned external memory contract

localDecisions: AI-backed analyze and discover timeouts use HTTP 504 with MODEL_TIMEOUT
Model API connect timeout is 2 seconds
Model API response timeout is 15 seconds
BE-owned authenticated session context and logout routes are published
Session context may include a public NFA fire-station coordinate as a station fallback position
Record save requires coded field outcomes and BE derives incident substance and RuleEngine risk facts from authoritative snapshots
Authenticated incident-scoped transcription proxy accepts bounded WAV and never exposes Speech API credentials to browsers
Transcription output requires responder review and cannot perform chemical identification, CAS confirmation, or risk assessment
Authenticated pre-incident transcription supports voice-first intake without inventing an incident scope
Authenticated confirmation cancellation requires the exact active role and confirmation ID, preserves a separate audit event, and forces reanalysis
Speech runtime output exposes validated nullable model provenance and never treats artifact identity as accuracy or safety validation
BE validates the upstream schema, request ID, exact fields, and safety boundary before projection
BE does not automatically retry transcription requests
BE accepts the complete provenance field set or the deployed legacy field set during rolling migration; legacy output is explicitly unverified
BE rejects partial, malformed, or internally inconsistent model provenance
Public replay is PUBLIC_SYNTHETIC and never represents authorized 119 dispatch
Replay uses one SSE incident.accepted event and is disabled by default
Public replay accepts no caller-provided incident payload
Synthetic confirmation accepts only replay-issued incident IDs and server-fixed CAS values
Every station in the pinned 17-region 215-station NFA public snapshot receives 15 deterministic scenarios
Synthetic demo logs are stored separately from operational response records
Every response is PUBLIC_SYNTHETIC with operationalRecord false and requires a signed station session
Fixture contains no personal information and preserves source disclosure
Fixture is explicitly synthetic and cannot represent an official field confirmation
